notes.submission_gate: Drafting, scanning and staging are automatic. Sending an application is never automatic: the deny rules block apply/submit calls, and the candidate applies personally from the link in each jobs/ folder. See .claude/agents/application-reviewer.md.
notes.session_start: The SessionStart hook runs scripts/onboarding_status.py. It tells Claude to run the onboarding interview until the candidate's profile is complete.
